claim: David Wilcock (March 8, 1973 – April 20, 2026) was a prominent figure in the UFO 'disclosure' movement — an author, a Gaia host ('Wisdom Teachings,' 'Cosmic Disclosure'), a regular on History's 'Ancient Aliens,' and a narrator of the 2018 documentary 'Above Majestic,' which argues that a hidden elite and a secret space program conceal extraterrestrial contact from the public. He died at 53 at his home in Nederland, Colorado. His family and law enforcement described a self-inflicted gunshot wound; the death, per the public record, 'was witnessed by law enforcement officers who had responded to an earlier 911 call he placed,' after what his family called 'a long struggle with depression and overwhelming financial debt.' In 'Above Majestic,' Wilcock stated that a 'hidden elite' practices 'corruption ... rape ... pedophilia ... child trafficking ... human sacrifice ... cannibalism' as 'part of their religious sacrament,' and 'advertise themselves' through symbols in movies, video games, television, music videos, and awards ceremonies. The film also quotes President Ronald Reagan's September 21, 1987 address to the UN General Assembly — 'is not an alien force already among us?' The framing that Wilcock was 'silenced' by 'people in power' over what he knew is an attributed inference; the contemporaneous account — a 911 call he placed, responding officers present at the scene, and a documented history of depression and debt — is suicide.
